verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev documents waitpoint tokens that pause task runs until the token is completed, explicitly for approval workflows and waiting on external confirmation. A `needsApproval` tool flag pauses for human approval while the run stays alive, and checkpoint-resume with no timeouts supports long waits. Community wish-list comments asking for wait/resume read as feature requests rather than reported failures, so they do not create a dispute. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that waits can last hours or days (e.g., token timeout limits), detail on how quickly runs resume once completed, and independent hands-on corroboration.
